name: Forth Eorlingas!
oracle_text:
Create X 2/2 red Human Knight creature tokens with trample and haste.
Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to one or more players this turn, you become the monarch.
blocked_sentences: Create X 2/2 red Human Knight creature tokens with trample and haste.
Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to one or more players this turn, you become the monarch.

needs.what: An op a spell can resolve that installs an *event-watching* delayed triggered ability for the rest of the turn (603.7): "Whenever <event> this turn, <effects>", built from a `trigger` spec out of `trigger_events` plus `effects`, expiring at cleanup, with no permanent to hang it on. This card needs the batched form of `deals_combat_damage_to_player` -- "one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to one or more players" fires once for the whole combat damage batch, not once per creature and not once per player, so the installer needs a once-per-event-batch flag (the same shape as the existing `This ability triggers only once each turn` handling) rather than firing X times when X Knights connect.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `delay` is the only op that schedules anything for later and it is step-scoped, not event-scoped: `op_delay` (`engine/effects/ops_control.py:375-400`) appends a `DelayedTrigger` whose only timing knob is `step`, validated against `DELAY_STEPS = {upkeep, draw_step, begin_combat, end_step}` (`engine/turn.py:79-84`), so it can say "at the beginning of the next end step" and cannot say "whenever a creature deals combat damage". Putting the sentence in `abilities` is not open either: this is a Sorcery, and a spell's effects must live in `spell_effects` -- a triggered ability on a sorcery would be watching from the graveyard, where the card sits after it resolves, so it would either never fire or fire for the rest of the game rather than for this turn. `combat_damage_by` in `condition_keys` reads the turn ledger *backwards* (prowl: "was a player dealt combat damage this turn by a Faerie") and only by creature subtype -- it can be asked at cast time but cannot make anything happen later, and this card's whole point is that the damage comes after the sorcery resolves. `set_flag` marks a permanent and no combat damage handler reads flags.

needs.what: The monarch designation as game state: at most one player is the monarch at a time, that player draws a card at the beginning of their end step, and a player becomes the monarch whenever a creature they control deals combat damage to the monarch. Needs the designation stored on GameState (a player id or None) and those two automatic behaviours wired into the end step and the combat damage step. Already requested by `aragorn_king_of_gondor`, `champions_of_minas_tirith` and `crown_of_gondor`; this card adds no new requirement beyond them (it never asks "if you're the monarch", so it does not need the `is_monarch` condition those cards want).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `set_flag`/`has_flag` is the nearest thing in `reference` and only stores an opaque per-card boolean on a battlefield permanent: it is not exclusive across players, nothing moves it when a creature deals combat damage to its holder, and no end-step draw hangs off it -- so a card written on flags would print "you become the monarch" and deliver none of what monarch means. It is worse than useless on this card in particular, because the source is a sorcery that is in the graveyard by the time the trigger would fire, so there is no permanent to carry the flag at all. `has_city_s_blessing` is the only player-level designation in `condition_keys` and is a different, permanent, non-exclusive one (ascend). `docs/rules-coverage.md:242-244` records the monarch and the initiative as not implemented; nothing in `src/` matches /monarch/.

needs.what: An op that makes a player the monarch -- `become_monarch` with a player selector ("you" is all this card needs) -- setting the designation above and firing whatever triggers watch it change. Same request as `aragorn_king_of_gondor` and `champions_of_minas_tirith`; noted here because this card needs it to be callable from inside a delayed trigger's `effects`, i.e. with the spell's controller captured at resolution rather than read off a battlefield source.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op in `ops` grants a player-level designation. `set_flag` is the closest and writes a card-scoped flag with no game-wide meaning; there is no monarch state for any op to set until the engine need above lands.

closest_existing: monarch (already requested by aragorn_king_of_gondor, champions_of_minas_tirith, crown_of_gondor)
rest_is_expressible: Both printed lines are blocked, so no partial answer was written. Everything except the four needs above already exists: `{X}{R}{W}` with `amount: {"x": true}` is a solved pattern, and once a `human_knight_2_2_r_trample_haste` token is registered the first sentence is a single `create_token` in `spell_effects`. Writing only that half would have produced a card that makes X Knights and then never gives the monarchy to anybody -- the residual gate would reject it for leaving the second printed line unclaimed, and a player casting it would have no way to tell that half the card is missing. Note also that the card is untestable in the sandbox even once unblocked in the sense that matters: combat is declined there and nothing deals combat damage after the spell, so the monarch half cannot be asserted; the honest expectation would be `zone: "graveyard"` plus `tokens` and `battlefield_count` for the token half.
